name: io.github.vedantnimbarte/kortex-memory
title: Kortex Memory
description: Multi-tenant memory for LLMs and AI coding agents: hybrid retrieval over your own Postgres, with scopes, RBAC, sensitivity tiers, contradiction surfacing and an auditable review queue.

environmentVariables.name: KORTEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A kx_* key from `kortex key create`. Scopes every read and write to one org.

environmentVariables.name: KORTEX_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Async SQLAlchemy DSN for the Kortex Postgres, e.g. postgresql+asyncpg://kortex:kortex@localhost:5432/kortex. The stdio transport talks to the database directly; use the SSE remote below if the client has no database access.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <kx_* API key>. Kortex is self-hosted, so replace the host with your own deployment.
